strict_scale_note: The COMP-3 SKU unpacker is intentionally compact domain logic. Use the non-strict profile; do not pad solver-visible LOC to satisfy large-system scale diagnostics.

root_cause_clusters.RC1_COMP3_ENCODING: Packed decimal is treated as opaque bytes instead of a typed digit/sign/scale encoding.
root_cause_clusters.RC2_REDEFINES: REDEFINES is modeled as sequential storage instead of an alias over the target bytes.
root_cause_clusters.RC3_ODO: OCCURS DEPENDING ON is modeled as its maximum span instead of the runtime depending-on count.
root_cause_clusters.RC4_REPORT_SEMANTICS: Evaluation summaries are inferred from SKU-specific values instead of parser outcomes and layout semantics.

defects.observable_failure: QOH is rendered as hexadecimal bytes instead of a decimal value.
A D-nibble negative packed value loses its negative sign.
Implied decimal scale and trailing zeroes are not preserved exactly.
Signed fields accept the unsigned F sign or unsigned fields accept signed C/D signs.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Accept every COBOL sign nibble without consulting the field signedness.

defects.observable_failure: A non-zero left storage pad nibble is silently discarded.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Slice the last N digit nibbles without validating discarded storage.

defects.observable_failure: ACTIVE-FLAG reads a later byte instead of sharing STATUS-BYTE storage.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Copy the public STATUS value after parsing instead of honoring alias offsets.

defects.observable_failure: BIN-COUNT zero still consumes the maximum OCCURS span and misaligns the next record.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Emit fewer entries but still advance by the maximum allocation.

defects.observable_failure: An ODO count outside the declared min/max range is accepted or clamped.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Clamp invalid counts and hide malformed input.

defects.observable_failure: Malformed packed fields can leave comp3_signed_ok true because the summary is SKU-specific.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Check one known negative QOH instead of every packed field and parser error.

defects.observable_failure: Malformed ODO input can leave odo_lengths_ok true or produce misleading record traversal.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Compare only emitted list length without honoring parser errors.
